import pandas as pd, json
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
feats=[c for c in tr.columns if c!='outcome']

acc=accuracy_score(te['outcome'],m.predict(te[feats]))

imp=pd.Series(m.feature_importances_,index=feats).sort_values()
ax=imp.plot.barh(title='Random forest feature importance'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('live/feature_importance.png',dpi=100)
